---
title: "Overall survival with unrestricted follow-up — invitation-acceptance comparisons"
subtitle: "Descriptive Kaplan–Meier curves"
format: html
---

- Descriptive only: uptake is post-randomization, so uptake comparisons are not causal.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(survival)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

results_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "07-acceptance-kaplan-meier", "results"
)
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Comparison groups

```{r}
#| label: comparison-groups
#| include: false

cohort <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
) |>
  mutate(
    tx_plot = group_factor(tx),
    uptake = case_when(
      tx == 0 ~ "Usual care",
      invitation_accepted == 1 ~ "ctDNA, accepted",
      invitation_accepted == 0 ~ "ctDNA, declined",
      is.na(invitation_accepted) ~ "ctDNA, not offered"
    ),
    uptake = factor(
      uptake,
      levels = c("Usual care", "ctDNA, accepted", "ctDNA, declined", "ctDNA, not offered")
    )
  )

max_follow_up <- max(cohort$survival_time_days_unrestricted, na.rm = TRUE)
risk_times <- seq(0, max_follow_up, by = 100)

comparison_groups <- c("randomized-groups" = "tx_plot", "uptake-groups" = "uptake")
```

## Kaplan–Meier curves

```{r}
#| label: build-plots
#| include: false

km_plots <- imap(comparison_groups, \(grouping, group) {
  km_fit <- survfit2(
    Surv(survival_time_days_unrestricted, status_death_unrestricted) ~ group,
    data = cohort |> mutate(group = .data[[grouping]]),
    conf.type = "log-log"
  )

  # Kaplan–Meier only, so solid lines; theme = NULL uses the report theme.
  km_plot <- ggsurvfit(km_fit, linewidth = 0.55, theme = NULL) +
    add_censor_mark(size = 1.8) +
    (if (grouping == "uptake") scale_colour_uptake() else scale_colour_group()) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = risk_times) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, max_follow_up), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(
      x = "Days since random selection",
      y = "Survival probability",
      colour = NULL,
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    add_risktable(
      times = risk_times,
      risktable_stats = c("n.risk", "cum.event"),
      stats_label = list(n.risk = "At risk", cum.event = "Events")
    )

  save_figure(
    ggsurvfit_build(km_plot),
    file.path(results_dir, paste0("kaplan-meier-", group, ".png")),
    height = if (grouping == "uptake") 7.5 else 6.5
  )

  km_plot
})
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-supporting-os-unrestricted-randomized-km
#| fig-cap: "Kaplan–Meier estimates using unrestricted follow-up in the randomized groups"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6.5
#| echo: false

km_plots[["randomized-groups"]]
```
